notes.title: Shop Customization Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone,[/h1]

The [b]Shop Update[/b] is here!

Thank you all for your patience and support. We hope you enjoy this update.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[b]New Shop Design[/b]
We've decided to focus more on shop customization, as it was limited, and we cannot build upon it. As a result, we've redesigned the shop to make it more customizable. You can now expand the shop multiple times and change wall colors as well as purchase additional shelves. These changes will also allow us to add more machines to the backroom in the future and improve the late game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/e35de3b8675fd762d917fb526e67fc807919704d.png[/img]
[b]You can also upgrade the shop even further now![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/d44013dd7eb725315e2c76a7cf27539d62380782.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/1b4962a0fefcac0389b16dcc0eb0beff8d59e074.png[/img]

[h1]Customization[/h1]
You can now purchase different wall, door colors and floor textures!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/a8f10f8c50ee71cf097bb87daa31ecaa6cd2b605.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/5cd0fe98437c71d6e80e0b94a0ba17fcbaa8d49e.png[/img]

[h1]Additional Shelves[/h1]
You can now purchase new shelves and place them however you like!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/45397b301606a9810ebcfa95d50d08923eeace11.gif[/img]

[h1]Home[/h1]
Who doesn't love it's own home? Now you can purchase your own house and decorate it! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/b8c90ae6d72fccc3dfcc5a90655355c6b700ccc8.png[/img]


[h1]General Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added 7 new items.
[*]Added new customer models.
[*]Added inverse mouse settings.
[*]Instead of quitting you can now return to the menu.
[*]Added typing numbers to the casino bets.
[*]Graphic quality options.
[*]Added trash bin to the auction planets
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed thief sometimes drops an unpickable item.
[*]Fixed unable to withdraw stackable items from storage when inventory is full.
[*]Fixed some bugs related to the repair machine.
[/list]

Since this update changes some in-game stuff, please let us know if you encounter a bug. We hope you enjoy this update. 
Thank you!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
[h1] Hello everyone,[/h1]

It's been a month since we've released [b]Pawn Planet[/b] and we would like to thank everyone who has played our game!

Firstly, here are some cool pictures of what we're working on;

[h3]New items.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/befa97303f4aad72eae8963845354c59226ac823.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/6d7afc2de9cb0ff7889a0d1b5a69910b2f82c4fd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/ef6ce15bd8cf8ffe411a9316cafe363d8f48318e.png[/img]

[h3]New customer model.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/05cc6740226571c5d98f45b0a53b3f20f11dc484.jpg[/img]
[h3]New spaceships cosmetics.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/39555e3d9089636cdd6f8a4450e14680b5e0dffb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Home Sweet Home[/h1]
We're also adding a house! Now you can purchase a house and add decorations in it. When you purchase a house, you'll gain extra item storage and be able to sleep in it. [b]Pets[/b] will also be able to live inside the house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/b8c90ae6d72fccc3dfcc5a90655355c6b700ccc8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/a3477735eb0f9aa7c979f341fbc8227f24d2fc99.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/f0e4457b4dcc3891135cd2c45c47d2df928cfa96.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/d53d718d4e9ed3c05d84cad3bc3eef437ceb8c6a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Pets!?[/h3]
You can now adopt pets! Just make sure you feed them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/b22d5250e4def7c4bb286a3ef20d01956900f21e.jpg[/img]
We're still working on the pets and will publish more updates.

[h3]Moving shelves.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/eab56b3358222278df28ad9f4662af2a9fd17bbf.gif[/img]
We've implemented a way to change the position and rotation of shelves. Now you can place it however you like.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
We have also fixed reported bugs and improved a lot of gameplay elements which will be available in the upcoming update with a full list.

That's all for our second Devlog. Feel free to let us know if you encounter any bugs or have a feedback. 

Thank you!

[h3]Shelves[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/dec467f40e74a2ea5b359a319e900c52f972a43f.png[/img]

[b]Repair Speed Upgrade[/b]
This was one of the requested features. Now you can purchase a repair speed upgrade for bad items, reducing the time to just one day.

You can now upgrade your repair machine to be more durable. It will take longer to break down!

notes.title: Pawn Planet Early Access is Here!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone[/h2]

[h1]Pawn Planet is available right now![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/6191c1dcb4e087087a72a45e265f293c7fb14ee5.jpg[/img]

We received a lot of support and feedbacks during Next Fest and from our free game Pawn Planet First Sales. So thank you to everyone! Since this is a Early Access game, there could be some bugs player may encounter. Please do report them to us and will fix it asap.

Here's the new features and changes;

[h3]Changes & Updates[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/0b1351f2555e104e1e6bb8bb42091416c5a089e3.jpg[/img]
[b]New customer ships.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/043a8d6200bffe2c49a55540c9b360ddd02b0618.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/4f77eaea05df2d21ff575aa4cfc0b217809f4027.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/3de39e5117b289469350cb567fd0699f54b3469b.png[/img]
[b]Gamble Planet.[/b] 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/0e10588a65b7123d403993e8e91c9b4f60ae36c3.gif[/img]
[b]Vending Machine for customers.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/a25efae52d2f63dd159052e5e6acc37b523d6651.gif[/img]
[b]Get scrap from items.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/3049a64be3cab55e19ccfdd6007cc79cd9aa2372.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/19bffa1706ee713b27f2fbcbc75b9f7042068dd4.png[/img]
[b]New Decorations[/b]

[h3]More changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Unlocked all the planets for auction.
[*]More SFXs.
[*]Player spaceship graphical improvements.
[*]Many small improvements.
[*]Lots of bug fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
We would like to expand our game with more features and here is our current plan;

[h3]Item Codex[/h3]
This Codex will include all game items in locked state until player purchases. It will show price info, description and scrap of the item. 

[h3]Story Intro[/h3]
We want to include a short story to the start of the game. This will explain why player starting a job in the Pawn Planet.

[h3]More Items and Customers[/h3]
We are already working on some new customers and items. Wackier than ever.

[h3]New Mini Games[/h3]
Just like bug race and blackjack, we are thinking different games to the area and will add them in the upcoming updates.

That's it for our plans right now, if you have more ideas feel free to join our discord and talk to us;

[url=https://discord.gg/fg9REq62kr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342280/c2f711c01f9b5d5c7acba303fc3ff5194c3ab456.png[/img][/url]

I hope you enjoy our game, thank you everyone!
